chunks: And in the narration of Manṣūr ibn Yūnus, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
"Indeed, lying against Allah and against the Imams عليهم السلام causes the fasting person to break the fast."

key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةِ: the Imams, the divinely guided leaders in context
key_terms.يُفَطِّرُ: causes the fast to be broken or invalidated

ai.seo_question: Does lying about Allah or the Imams invalidate the fast?
ai.summary: This hadith states that attributing falsehood to Allah or to the Imams عليهم السلام invalidates the fast. It highlights both the sanctity of truth in religion and a legal ruling concerning what nullifies sawm (fasting).
